messages:
Amira (CEO): Heads-up: all-hands tomorrow 9:00am PT. Drop Qs here or use the anon form: https://forms.redwood.company/ah-q4-questions

Amira (CEO): Draft agenda: 1) Company snapshot + metrics (5m) 2) Launch highlight: Optimize suggestions pilot (10m) 3) Reliability update & recent incident recap (8m) 4) People update + hiring priorities (4m) 5) Q&A (18m)

Priya (Head of Product): Optimize pilot will show cost vs latency tradeoffs and a couple customer stories. Planning a 5min demo of the UI.

Liam (CTO): Incident recap will cover the short outage on 2025-01-08 (control-plane throttling). I'll include root cause, impact, and the new rate-limiter guard we added. Postmortem link: https://confluence.redwood.company/incidents/2025-01-08-cp-throttle

Jo (People Ops): Reminder: open enrollment window starts next week. Also we'll announce expanded learning stipend and updated WFH guidelines during the people section.

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled for 30 minutes before meeting. Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.company/allhands-q4

--- (meeting occurs) ---

AllHands Bot: Recording: https://videos.redwood.company/allhands-q4-1732001123.mp4

Amira (CEO): Thank you all for attending. Threading concise takeaways; correct me if anything off.

Amira (CEO): TAKEAWAYS: 1) Revenue and usage continue to grow; retention steady. 2) Optimize pilot launching to 20 customers next week. 3) Control-plane throttling incident root cause fixed; mitigations deployed. 4) Hiring focus: SRE, runtime infra, and customer success.

Priya (Head of Product): Optimize pilot details: - Goals: reduce token cost by 18% without increasing p50 latency beyond 5% - Wave 1: 20 customers, opt-in - Feedback form: https://forms.redwood.company/optimize-pilot-feedback

Liam (CTO): INCIDENT: 2025-01-08 control-plane throttle lasted ~12 minutes, affected ~14% of requests globally. Root cause: a sudden spike in model rollout requests triggered a runaway retry loop. Fixes: rate-limiter guard, rollout debounce, added synthetic canary traffic to detect similar regressions. Runbook updated.

Liam (CTO): Action items: 1) Add rollout debounce to runtime library (assigned: eng-runtime), 2) add canary synthetic to deploy workflow (assigned: eng-sre), 3) add dashboard alert for rollout retry spikes (assigned: eng-infra).

Jo (People Ops): PEOPLE: open enrollment details in HR portal. Learning stipend increased to $1,200/year prorated for new hires. WFH guideline clarified: managers approve >3 days/week.

Amira (CEO): Q&A highlights: Q about Dedicated pricing changes -> not at this time. Q about incident transparency -> we will post an exec summary and link to the full postmortem.

EngineerX: Small ask: can eng-sre share the rollout debounce design in #eng-runtime so we can review?

Liam (CTO): Yep will post design doc by EOD.

Priya (Head of Product): Pilot signups: product will contact customers for onboarding. If you have product-marketing collateral suggestions, DM me.

Amira (CEO): Closing: appreciate the team's focus. If you couldn't make it, watch recording and leave follow-ups here or in the anonymous form. :sparkles:
